Virus infection causes diffusion of pigments from the seed hilum, resulting in mottling of the seed coat. Hilum color determines the color and intensity of seed coat discoloration.. Early symptoms include seed rot and damping off; the most characteristic symptom is a dark brown lesion on the lower stem extending up from the taproot, which can girdle the stem causing stunting or death..
